text: Jameed is the curd of churned sour yoghurt, strained, heavily salted and dried in the sun. Low moisture, low pH and high salt together let it keep for up to two years.

links.name: Hamad et al., J. Food Technology Research 3(2) (2016)

steps.note: The curd is kneaded with a heavy amount of salt.

processing.text: The sour yoghurt is churned, and the heated buttermilk curd is kneaded with salt.
